en: Changed Team and Enterprise sessions, and sessions whose sign-in plan Claude Code can't determine, to withhold WebFetch until the organization policy loads if it couldn't be loaded at startup
zh: 变更 Team 和 Enterprise session，以及 Claude Code 无法确定登录计划的 session：如果在启动时无法加载组织策略，则在策略加载完成前暂不提供 WebFetch
